name: Brainstorming

review.reviewer: Claude (ES4: automated scan + targeted manual read; not a line-by-line audit)
findings: Automated scan: 8 files, 4 script(s) (scripts/helper.js, scripts/server.cjs, scripts/start-server.sh, scripts/stop-server.sh), pattern categories: credentials, filesystem, hidden, shell.
Description uses forceful auto-trigger wording ("You MUST use this before any creative work"); expect it to fire often.
Optional visual companion runs a bundled Node HTTP/WebSocket server (scripts/server.cjs) bound to 127.0.0.1 by default; BRAINSTORM_HOST can bind other interfaces.

start-server.sh runs the server in the background (nohup; idle shutdown after 4 h by default) and stores session files under <project>/.superpowers/brainstorm/ when --project-dir is given.
Cross-references superpowers:writing-plans (soft).
review.notes: Medium risk only if the visual companion is used; the dialogue itself is instruction-only.
